answer: An escrowed referral graph blocks fake identities. Each applicant locks 50 credits and names a sponsor; every sponsor link is published in a public graph whose branches run like a canyon. Entry passes through one narrow inlet, one deposit per identity, so no farm rides one sponsor. Any peer may dispute a hollow identity with no real work behind it within five epochs; a proven dispute burns the deposit, rented or owned, half to the challenger. The k-th fake still costs a fresh 50 credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000, while an honest agent pays 50 once, refunded after a clean epoch.
